user.title: Connect Sportabler (Abler)
user.description: Sportabler's login is gated by SMS + reCAPTCHA and can't be automated from Home Assistant. [Open the Sportabler login page](https://abler.io/sign-on/) and log in there with your phone number as usual, then come back here and press Next.

token.title: Paste your session token
token.description: Log in to Abler in your browser, then copy the refreshToken cookie from developer tools → Application/Storage → Cookies → https://www.abler.io. Session cookies are saved when the server rotates them. Sessions may still expire or be revoked.

error.invalid_auth: That refresh token was rejected. Log in again in your browser and copy a fresh `refreshToken` cookie value.

abort.already_configured: This Sportabler account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: Log in with the same Abler account as this integration.

init.title: Request frequency
init.description: Choose how often to fetch schedule changes. Manual only still fetches once on startup or reload; use homeassistant.update_entity on a Sportabler entity for later updates. Profiles are cached for 24 hours. Saving changes reloads the integration.
